name: Shinomiya Aoi
source:
Likes: Creative Cooking
Kazami Academy Third Year Class 1

An upperclassman who is admired for his long hair and princely looks.
He looks nice but he can be surprisingly harsh on people, at times he treats the protagonist like a pet.
